**[comments] Rule 5, a call-site comment says only why here: cut**

This restates the k_source_row(view) overload's own comment in h/tron/tensor/k_vnni.hpp:240-243 and the Aligned/Dma template flags that const_k_row_view deduces from the view. It says what the helper does, not why the call sits here.

Proposed: cut the comment.
